# Build systems to grow revenue

![Colorful playful contraption with tubes, balls, magnets, and funnel on green hills under blue sky.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a231084ed9c142b6d5c41c6_hero-still_v3.avif)

Data

### Get data from the most complete data marketplace

One contract to buy data from 200+ data and AI vendors in Clay’s marketplace. Create intent signals from anything on the internet. Bring 1st and 3rd party data together.

![Anthropic Logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a19d21cf5433eaf16559d34_anthropic-mark.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0e5cc36c6c1fb12fafec17_intercom-mark.svg)

![Mistral ai logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a19cc922508a770f774386d_mistralai.svg)

**Anthropic** 3x’d their enrichment rate with Clay’s data marketplace.

**Intercom** grew outbound pipeline 140% by continuously researching target accounts for headcount change, technographics, and web intent.

**Mistral** AI cut the time to map their TAM and score accounts from 2 months to 10 days.

![Blue magnifying glass showing enlarged orange ball near a tray with pink, red, and blue balls.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a230420e94a7c3edcefe6df_Data-Still%201.avif)

agents

### Put agents that know your business to work

Run GTM plays with agents that understand your business and accounts. Turn context into research, scoring, and personalized outreach, with shared learning that makes each play smarter.

![OpenAI logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0f9da98e6616e14184123c_openai-mark.svg)

![Canva logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0fa04090e5a20076dda461_canva-mark.svg)

![Verkada logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0fa08bf5aa625a3043914f_vanta-mark.svg)

**OpenAI** used Clay to fully automate pre-call prep by researching prospect bios, earning reports, and company changes in the last 90 days.

**Canva** saved 4 hrs/rep/week by automating contact sourcing to feed their agentic AI outbound motion.

**Vanta** cut post-call follow-up time from 3 days to <1 with agents tailoring messaging based on SOC 2 badges, compliance signals, and security job posts.

![Small retro robot with a square head, blue and red eyes, and an orange satellite dish on top.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a230420f8c4e2d47d16de94_Agents-Still%201.avif)

orchestration

### Build GTM plays on a visual canvas

Use clicks, code, or chat with Clay to build GTM plays you can easily see. Troubleshoot faster, collaborate across teams, and reuse logic across all of your runs.

![Eleven Labs Logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a19d0fa0946858e6cbb4ad4_elevenlabs-mark.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0f9dc63998c216525e3954_v-mark.svg)

![Lovable logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0fa066588fad364ee3f091_lovable-mark.svg)

**ElevenLabs**’ increased SQLs by +50% by reducing speed-to-lead to <5 mins.

**Verkada** 2x’d warm lead replies by automatically analyzing email replies to route to the right nurture campaign.

**Lovable** booked 50% more qualified meetings per rep by routing prospects to best-fit rep based on firmographics and current company priorities.

![Green puzzle cube with paths fitting colored balls near matching shape holes and ramps with balls.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a2304209a92a279ce577172_Orch-Still%201.avif)

ACTIVATION

### Launch new plays as fast as you have ideas

Trigger emails, ads, and more with integrations to your existing GTM tools. Write 1:1 messaging for every prospect programmatically. Launch new tests in days.

![Rippling logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a19d14446f706677e064370_rippling-mark.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a2370e1303e00f4e41117aa_legora-mark.svg)

![Figma logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a0f9de05192826ecf1acdfa_figma-mark.svg)

**Rippling** 2x’d cold email performance by automatically tailoring email copy based on persona and enriched account data.

**Legora** increased qualified lead volume +60% using research agents to trigger personalized campaigns to ICPs based on their public interests.

**Figma** increased PLG conversion by automatically prospecting into self-serve accounts with both usage spikes and recent hiring signals.

![Pink mechanical lever with cubes showing bell, megaphone, and paper plane icons catching colored balls.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a230421656b77ff82758b42_Execution-Still%201.avif)

GTM INFRASTRUCTURE

### Build systems that make reps more productive

Reps can self-serve the best prospecting data. Chat to get full account context in natural language. Build centralized workflows for any rep to run.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a19d4e456842bfe0c1ea942_pendo-mark.svg)

![Hex ai tech logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a2371bba98c22a3005fcd06_hex-mark.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/6a237276303e00f4e4114292_terrappin-mark.svg)

**Pendo** reps hit 200% of quota using agents for account research, tailored messaging and pre-call prep.

**Hex** sales reps got a +50% lift in their close-rate by contacting qualified leads the same-day they show intent.

**Terrapinn** generates +19% more revenue per rep and reduced acquisition cost by 90% using Claygent to find and qualify leads.
